split: embryo-level 90/10; fixed epochs; held-out test evaluated once
fairness_controls: same embryo split within each seed
same model initialization within each seed
same data order within each seed

loss_variants.ce: ordinary cross entropy without class correction
loss_variants.inverse_freq_ce: existing project approach: inverse-frequency weighted cross entropy
loss_variants.effective_num_ce: class-balanced loss using effective sample number (Cui et al., 2019)
loss_variants.class_balanced_focal: effective-number alpha plus focal hard-example modulation

selection_rule: Prefer a method that improves macro-F1, balanced accuracy and tail recall without a material accuracy decrease; do not select by test performance in a final paper protocol.
